question: What is the meaning of internationally recognized product id in relation to product identification?
description: An internationally recognized product ID is a unique identifier used to identify a product across different countries and markets. It is part of the product identification process, ensuring that products can be consistently identified and tracked globally. This ID is used in conjunction with other identifiers, such as the product name and brand name, to provide comprehensive product identification information.
